args.title: Add field limits to the API documentation for /reports
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The API documentation for the /reports endpoints should include field limits, such as the maximum number of categories, maximum length for report names, and the maximum number of schedule recipients.

file: docs/API.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The API documentation for the /reports endpoints is missing field limits, such as the maximum number of categories, maximum length for report names, and the maximum number of schedule recipients. These limits should be added to aid in client-side validation.
